07

Limites e dívidas

A auditoria Lighthouse prevista no RNF-04 não foi executada: a evidência cobre só o chunk separado. Os dados de limite, fechamento, vencimento e parcela foram removidos do banco, e a migração não tem reversão. O Autocomplete divide value e onChange por multiple em dois tipos, o que diverge da interface escrita na spec, e quem o consumir deve usar o tipo do modo.

Na rolagem única, a conferência manual do leitor, do quadro de Projetos e da paleta de comandos não ficou registrada. O print do navegador Zen é uma evidência manual, enviada pelo usuário. No diálogo de conta de destino, se a conta excluída não estiver no cache, o saldo da conta de destino só se atualiza depois da releitura.

Os scripts de evidência ficam fora do ESLint e são conferidos só com node --check e Prettier. O check-chart-chunk.mjs identifica o chunk do painel pela chave finance.panel.monthly_label, e renomeá-la exige atualizar o script. finance-panel-screen.module.css ainda tem .positive e .negative próprias para Economias e perdas, separadas das do MoneyAmount.

233pub struct CardUsage {
234 /// Saídas menos entradas da fatura aberta, pelo valor liquidado ou previsto.
235 pub open_statement_amount: i64,
236 /// As não liquidadas do cartão mais as liquidadas da fatura aberta.
237 pub used_limit_amount: i64,
238}

240/// Uso do cartão a partir das movimentações dele e do período da fatura aberta.
241pub fn card_usage(items: &[Transaction], open: StatementPeriod) -> CardUsage {
242 let charge = |item: &Transaction, amount: i64| -item.kind.signed(amount);
243 let mut usage = CardUsage::default();
244 for item in items {
245 let in_open = item.statement_period == Some(open);
246 if in_open {
247 usage.open_statement_amount = usage
248 .open_statement_amount
249 .saturating_add(charge(item, item.value()));
250 }
251 if !item.is_settled() || in_open {
252 usage.used_limit_amount = usage
253 .used_limit_amount
254 .saturating_add(charge(item, item.value()));
255 }
256 }
257 usage
258}

244/// Meses do "Mês a mês": os realizados terminam no mês de hoje (RF-15, RF-17).
245pub const MONTHLY_REALIZED_MONTHS: u32 = 6;
246pub const MONTHLY_PROJECTED_MONTHS: u32 = 6;
247
248/// Um mês do "Mês a mês": `month` é o primeiro dia do mês e `balance`, o saldo ao fim
249/// dele. Os projetados vêm das pendentes e das recorrentes, sem linhas gravadas (RN-08).
250#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
251pub struct MonthTotals {
252 pub month: NaiveDate,
253 pub income: i64,
254 pub expense: i64,
255 pub balance: i64,
256 pub projected: bool,
257}
258
259fn first_of_month(day: NaiveDate) -> NaiveDate {
260 day.with_day(1).unwrap_or(day)
261}
262
263fn last_of_month(first: NaiveDate) -> NaiveDate {
264 first
265 .checked_add_months(Months::new(1))
266 .and_then(|next| next.pred_opt())
267 .unwrap_or(first)
268}
269
270/// Do primeiro dia do mês de hoje menos 5 meses ao último dia do mês de hoje mais 6.
271pub fn monthly_window(today: NaiveDate) -> Period {
272 let current = first_of_month(today);
273 let from = current
274 .checked_sub_months(Months::new(MONTHLY_REALIZED_MONTHS - 1))
275 .unwrap_or(today);
276 let to = current
277 .checked_add_months(Months::new(MONTHLY_PROJECTED_MONTHS))
278 .map_or(today, last_of_month);
279 Period { from, to }
280}
281
282/// 12 meses consecutivos: os realizados somam as liquidadas pela data efetiva e voltam
283/// do saldo atual; os projetados somam as pendentes pela data prevista e usam o saldo
284/// previsto, que inclui as atrasadas (RF-17, CB-08).
285pub fn monthly_series(
286 settled: &[FinanceItem],
287 pending: &[FinanceItem],
288 current_balance: i64,
289 today: NaiveDate,
290) -> Vec<MonthTotals> {
291 let start = monthly_window(today).from;
292 (0..MONTHLY_REALIZED_MONTHS + MONTHLY_PROJECTED_MONTHS)
293 .filter_map(|offset| start.checked_add_months(Months::new(offset)))
294 .map(|month| {
295 if month > first_of_month(today) {
296 projected_month(pending, current_balance, month, today)
297 } else {
298 realized_month(settled, current_balance, month)
299 }
300 })
301 .collect()
302}
303
304fn realized_month(settled: &[FinanceItem], current_balance: i64, month: NaiveDate) -> MonthTotals {
305 let end = last_of_month(month);
306 let mut totals = MonthTotals {
307 month,
308 income: 0,
309 expense: 0,
310 balance: current_balance,
311 projected: false,
312 };
313 for item in settled {
314 let Some(done) = item.settlement() else {
315 continue;
316 };
317 let date = item.effective_date();
318 if date > end {
319 totals.balance = totals
320 .balance
321 .saturating_sub(item.kind().signed(done.settled_amount));
322 } else if date >= month {
323 add_to(&mut totals, item.kind(), done.settled_amount);
324 }
325 }
326 totals
327}
328
329fn projected_month(
330 pending: &[FinanceItem],
331 current_balance: i64,
332 month: NaiveDate,
333 today: NaiveDate,
334) -> MonthTotals {
335 let end = last_of_month(month);
336 let mut totals = MonthTotals {
337 month,
338 income: 0,
339 expense: 0,
340 balance: forecast_balance(current_balance, pending, end, today).unwrap_or(current_balance),
341 projected: true,
342 };
343 for item in pending {
344 let date = item.expected_date();
345 if !item.is_settled() && date >= month && date <= end {
346 add_to(&mut totals, item.kind(), item.expected_amount());
347 }
348 }
349 totals
350}
351
352fn add_to(totals: &mut MonthTotals, kind: TransactionKind, amount: i64) {
353 match kind {
354 TransactionKind::Income => totals.income = totals.income.saturating_add(amount),
355 TransactionKind::Expense => totals.expense = totals.expense.saturating_add(amount),
356 }
357}

103fn installments(
104 account: &Account,
105 base: Transaction,
106 count: u32,
107 env: Env<'_>,
108) -> Outcome<Vec<Transaction>> {
109 let Some(terms) = account.card else {
110 return Err(FinanceError::invalid(
111 "installments",
112 "requires_credit_card",
113 ));
114 };
115 if base.kind != TransactionKind::Expense {
116 return Err(FinanceError::invalid("installments", "requires_expense"));
117 }
118 let plan = terms
119 .cycle
120 .plan_installments(base.expected_date, base.expected_amount, count)?;
121 let group_id = base.id;
122 Ok(plan
123 .into_iter()
124 .map(|planned| Transaction {
125 id: if planned.number == 1 {
126 base.id
127 } else {
128 env.ids.new_id()
129 },
130 expected_amount: planned.amount,
131 expected_date: planned.expected_date,
132 installment: Some(Installment {
133 number: planned.number,
134 total: planned.total,
135 }),
136 installment_group_id: Some(group_id),
137 statement_period: Some(planned.period),
138 ..base.clone()
139 })
140 .collect())
141}

252 .map(FinanceItem::Stored)
253 .collect();

255 Ok(monthly_series(&settled, &pending, current_balance, today))
256}

261async fn cards<T: TransactionRepository>(
262 transactions: &T,
263 all_accounts: &[Account],
264 owner_id: Uuid,
265 today: NaiveDate,
266) -> Outcome<Vec<CardView>> {

270 continue;
271 };
272 let open = terms.cycle.statement_for(today);
273 let items = transactions.statement_items(owner_id, account.id).await?;
274 views.push(CardView {
275 account: account.clone(),
276 credit_limit_amount: terms.credit_limit_amount,
277 statement_period: open,
278 due_date: terms.cycle.due_date(open),
279 usage: card_usage(&items, open),
280 });
281 }
282 Ok(views)
283}

323 async fn pay_statement(
324 &self,
325 draft: Transfer,
326 statement: StatementPeriod,
327 now: DateTime<Utc>,
328 ) -> Outcome<StatementPayment> {
329 let owner_id = draft.owner_id;
330 let card_id = draft.to_account_id;
331 let mut tx = begin(&self.pool, owner_id).await?;
332 // Ordem fixa das travas, para dois pedidos simultâneos não se travarem.
333 let mut accounts = [draft.from_account_id, card_id];
334 accounts.sort();
335 for account_id in accounts {
336 lock_account(&mut tx, owner_id, account_id).await?;
337 }
338 let rows: Vec<TransactionRow> = sqlx::query_as!(TransactionRow, "SELECT id, owner_id, visibility AS \"visibility: _\", kind, account_id, \
339 category_id, description, expected_amount, expected_date AS \"expected_date: _\", settled_amount, settled_at AS \"settled_at: _\", \
340 difference_amount, difference_kind, currency, generated_from, occurrence_date AS \"occurrence_date: _\", \
341 installment_number, installment_total, installment_group_id, statement_period, \
342 created_at AS \"created_at: _\", updated_at AS \"updated_at: _\" FROM transactions \
343 WHERE owner_id = $1 AND account_id = $2 AND statement_period = $3 \
344 AND settled_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY expected_date, id FOR UPDATE", owner_id, card_id, statement.to_string())
345 .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
346 .await
347 .map_err(storage)?;
348 let mut items = rows
349 .into_iter()
350 .map(TransactionRow::into_domain)
351 .collect::<Outcome<Vec<Transaction>>>()?;
352 let amount = outstanding_amount(&items);
353 if amount <= 0 {
354 return Err(FinanceError::invalid("period", "nothing_to_pay"));
355 }
356 let mut card_delta = amount;
357 for item in &mut items {
358 let expected = item.expected_amount;
359 card_delta += item.settle(expected, draft.transferred_on, now)?;
360 save_settlement(&mut tx, item).await?;
361 }
362 let transfer = Transfer { amount, ..draft };
363 insert_transfer(&mut tx, &transfer).await?;
364 add_to_balance(&mut tx, owner_id, transfer.from_account_id, -amount, now).await?;
365 add_to_balance(&mut tx, owner_id, card_id, card_delta, now).await?;
366 commit(tx).await?;
367 Ok(StatementPayment {
368 transfer,
369 settled_transaction_ids: items.iter().map(|item| item.id).collect(),
370 })
371 }
372}258}

1103 };
1104 let period = statement_period(&period_text)?;
1105 let scope = format!("POST /credit-cards/{card_id}/statements/{period}/payment");
1106 idempotent(&state, user.user_id, &headers, scope, &body, || async {

1110 };
1111 let payment = credit_cards::pay(

1113 &PgTransactions::new(state.pool.clone()),
1114 env(&state),
1115 user.user_id,
1116 card_id,
1117 period,
1118 input,
1119 )
1120 .await
1121 .map_err(api_error)?;
1122 Ok((
1123 StatusCode::CREATED,
1124 to_json(StatementPaymentResponse::from(payment))?,
1125 ))
1126 })
1127 .await

213#[tokio::test]
214async fn ct04_deleting_account_moves_transactions_transfers_and_recurring_to_destination() {
215 let t = FinanceTest::new().await;
216 let checking = t.default_account(&t.alice).await;
217 let savings = t.create_account(&t.alice, "Poupança").await;
218 let wallet = t.create_account(&t.alice, "Carteira").await;
219 let income = settled(&t, &savings, "income", 100_000, "2026-11-01").await;
220 let expense = settled(&t, &savings, "expense", 30_000, "2026-11-02").await;
221 let planned = id_of(
222 &t.create_transaction(&t.alice, &savings, "expense", 5_000, "2026-11-20")
223 .await,
224 );
225 let recurring = id_of(
226 &t.create_recurring(
160 &t.alice,227 &t.alice,
161 &format!("/accounts/{id}"),228 &savings,
162 json!({ "due_day": 20 }),229 "expense",
230 5_000,
231 monthly_rule("2026-11-10", 10),
163 )232 )
233 .await,
234 );
235 let moved = transfer(&t, "ct04-transfer", &savings, &wallet, 10_000).await;
236 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &savings).await, 60_000);
237 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &wallet).await, 10_000);
238 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &checking).await, 0);
239 assert_eq!(current_balance(&t).await, 70_000);
240
241 let (status, body) = delete_moving(&t, &savings, &checking).await;
242
243 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NO_CONTENT, "{body}");
244 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &checking).await, 60_000);
245 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &wallet).await, 10_000);
246 let (status, _) = t.get(&t.alice, &format!("/accounts/{savings}")).await;
247 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NOT_FOUND);
248 for id in [&income, &expense, &planned] {
249 let item = fetch(&t, &format!("/transactions/{id}")).await;
250 assert_eq!(item["account_id"], checking.as_str(), "{item}");
251 }
252 let moved = fetch(&t, &format!("/transfers/{moved}")).await;
253 assert_eq!(moved["from_account_id"], checking.as_str());
254 assert_eq!(moved["to_account_id"], wallet.as_str());
255 let recurring = fetch(&t, &format!("/recurring-transactions/{recurring}")).await;
256 assert_eq!(recurring["account_id"], checking.as_str());
257 assert_eq!(current_balance(&t).await, 70_000);
258}

546#[tokio::test]
547async fn ct01_deleting_recurring_keeps_settled_copies_as_one_off_history() {
548 let t = FinanceTest::new().await;
549 let account = t.default_account(&t.alice).await;
550 let id = internet(&t, &account).await;
551 let (status, november) = t
552 .settle_occurrence(&t.alice, &id, "2026-11-10", 5_000, "2026-11-10")
553 .await;
554 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{november}");
555 let (status, december) = t
556 .settle_occurrence(&t.alice, &id, "2026-12-10", 5_000, "2026-12-10")
557 .await;
558 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{december}");
559 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &account).await, -10_000);
560
561 let (status, body) = t
562 .delete(&t.alice, &format!("/recurring-transactions/{id}"))
563 .await;
564
565 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NO_CONTENT, "{body}");
566 let (status, body) = t
567 .get(&t.alice, &format!("/recurring-transactions/{id}"))
568 .await;
569 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "{body}");
570 assert_eq!(body["code"], "not_found");
571 let recurring = t.items(&t.alice, "/recurring-transactions").await;
572 assert!(recurring.iter().all(|item| item["id"] != id.as_str()));
573 assert_eq!(
574 rows(
575 &t.items(&t.alice, "/transactions?from=2026-11-01&to=2027-03-31")
576 .await
577 ),
578 vec![
579 row("2026-11-10", 5_000, "settled", true),
580 row("2026-12-10", 5_000, "settled", true),
581 ]
582 );
583 for copy in [&november, &december] {
584 let stored = transaction(&t, &id_of(copy)).await;
585 assert!(stored["generated_from"].is_null(), "{stored}");
586 assert!(stored["occurrence_date"].is_null(), "{stored}");
587 }
588 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &account).await, -10_000);
589 assert_eq!(stored_transactions(&t).await, 2);
590}

593async fn ct02_deleting_never_settled_recurring_leaves_no_history_and_second_delete_is_404() {

602 assert_eq!(stored_transactions(&t).await, 0);
603 assert!(
604 t.items(&t.alice, "/transactions?from=2026-11-01&to=2027-03-31")
605 .await
606 .is_empty()
607 );
608 let (status, body) = t.delete(&t.alice, &uri).await;
609 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "{body}");
610 assert_eq!(body["code"], "not_found");
611 let (status, body) = t

617 .await;

621}

623#[tokio::test]
624async fn undo_settlement_of_copy_after_recurring_deletion_keeps_it_as_one_off() {
625 let t = FinanceTest::new().await;
626 let account = t.default_account(&t.alice).await;
627 let id = internet(&t, &account).await;
628 let (status, copy) = t
629 .settle_occurrence(&t.alice, &id, "2026-11-10", 5_000, "2026-11-10")
630 .await;
631 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{copy}");
632 let (status, body) = t
633 .delete(&t.alice, &format!("/recurring-transactions/{id}"))
634 .await;
635 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::NO_CONTENT, "{body}");
636
637 let (status, undone) = t.undo_settlement(&t.alice, &id_of(&copy)).await;
638
639 assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{undone}");
640 assert_eq!(undone["status"], "open");
641 assert!(undone["settled_at"].is_null(), "{undone}");
642 assert!(undone["generated_from"].is_null(), "{undone}");
643 assert_eq!(t.balance(&t.alice, &account).await, 0);
644 assert_eq!(stored_transactions(&t).await, 1);
645}

413 .expect("itens")

417 assert_eq!(listed, expected[..5]);
418}

476 .bind(file_id)
477 .execute(&mut *tx)
478 .await
479 .unwrap();
480 for (index, (tone, _)) in THEME_HEX.iter().enumerate() {
481 sqlx::query(
482 "INSERT INTO highlights (id, owner_id, book_id, file_id, page, color, text, rects, \
483 created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 1, $5, $6, $7, now(), \
484 now(), CASE WHEN $8 THEN now() END)",
485 )
486 .bind(Uuid::from_u128(10 + index as u128))
487 .bind(ALICE)
488 .bind(book_id)
489 .bind(file_id)
490 .bind(*tone)
491 .bind(format!("trecho {index}"))
492 .bind(rect())
493 .bind(index == THEME_HEX.len() - 1)
494 .execute(&mut *tx)
495 .await
496 .unwrap();
497 }
498 let count_before: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM highlights")
499 .fetch_one(&mut *tx)
500 .await
501 .unwrap();
502 tx.commit().await.unwrap();
503
504 library::migrator().run(pool).await.unwrap();
505 let mut tx = begin_for_user(pool, ALICE).await.unwrap();
506 let colors: Vec<String> = sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT color FROM highlights ORDER BY id")
507 .fetch_all(&mut *tx)
508 .await
509 .unwrap();
510 tx.commit().await.unwrap();
511 let mut tx = begin_for_user(pool, ALICE).await.unwrap();
512 let refused = sqlx::query(
513 "INSERT INTO highlights (id, owner_id, book_id, file_id, page, color, text, rects, \
514 created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 1, 'accent', 'novo', $5, now(), now())",
515 )
516 .bind(Uuid::from_u128(99))
517 .bind(ALICE)
518 .bind(book_id)
519 .bind(file_id)
520 .bind(rect())
521 .execute(&mut *tx)
522 .await;
523 drop(tx);
524
525 assert_eq!(count_before, 5);
526 assert_eq!(colors.len() as i64, count_before);
527 let expected: Vec<&str> = THEME_HEX.iter().map(|(_, hex)| *hex).collect();
528 assert_eq!(colors, expected);
529 assert!(colors.iter().all(|color| {
530 color.len() == 7
531 && color.starts_with('#')
532 && color[1..]
533 .chars()
534 .all(|c| matches!(c, '0'..='9' | 'a'..='f'))
535 }));
536 assert!(refused.is_err());
537}

36 * altura quando quebra de linha abaixo de 720 px (PD-20). */
37function useTopbarHeight(
38 shell: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>,
39 column: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>,
40) {
41 useLayoutEffect(() => {
42 const topbar = column.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(':scope > header');
43 if (!topbar) return;

45 shell.current?.style.setProperty('--topbar-h', `${String(topbar.offsetHeight)}px`);

47 measure();
48 window.addEventListener('resize', measure);
49 const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined' ? null : new ResizeObserver(measure);
50 observer?.observe(topbar);
51 return () => {
52 window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
53 observer?.disconnect();
54 };
55 });

20 bottom: number;

24/** Medidas da rolagem única (RF-23): janela, sidebar, topbar, área da página e rolagens internas. */
25async function layoutOf(page: Page) {
26 return page.evaluate(() => {
27 const box = (node: Element | null): Box => {
28 if (!node) throw new Error('elemento ausente');
29 const r = node.getBoundingClientRect();
30 return { top: r.top, bottom: r.bottom, height: r.height };
31 };
32 const sidebar = document.querySelector('aside');
33 const main = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('main[data-page-area]');
34 const topbar = main?.parentElement?.querySelector(':scope > header') ?? null;
35 const inner = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('body *')]
36 .filter((node) => {
37 if (sidebar?.querySelector('nav')?.contains(node)) return false;
38 const overflow = getComputedStyle(node).overflowY;
39 return (
40 node.scrollHeight > node.clientHeight + 1 &&
41 (overflow === 'auto' || overflow === 'scroll')
42 );
43 })
44 .map((node) => node.tagName.toLowerCase());
45 return {
46 scrollY: window.scrollY,
47 scrollHeight: document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
48 innerHeight: window.innerHeight,
49 sidebar: box(sidebar),
50 topbar: box(topbar),
51 main: box(main),
52 mainOverflowY: main ? getComputedStyle(main).overflowY : '',
53 inner,
54 };
55 });
56}

75const CURSOR_MARKER = () => {
76 const dot = document.createElement('div');
77 dot.style.cssText =
78 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;pointer-events:none;left:0;top:0;display:none;';
79 dot.innerHTML =
80 '<div style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#e11d48;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000"></div>';
81 const place = (event: MouseEvent) => {
82 dot.style.display = 'block';
83 dot.style.transform = `translate(${String(event.clientX - 6)}px, ${String(event.clientY - 6)}px)`;
84 };
85 window.addEventListener('mousemove', place, true);
86 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
87 document.body.append(dot);
88 });
89};

35/** A conta `a2` tem movimentações: sem `move_to` o servidor recusa; com `move_to=a1`, move e exclui. */
36function withTransactions(): FinanceWorld {
37 const state = seed();
38 state.override = (call) => {
39 if (call.method !== 'DELETE' || call.path !== '/accounts/a2') return undefined;
40 const move_to = call.url.searchParams.get('move_to');
41 if (move_to === null) return problem(409, 'account_has_transactions');
42 if (move_to !== 'a1') return undefined;
43 state.accounts = state.accounts.filter((entry) => entry.id !== 'a2');
44 const main = state.accounts.find((entry) => entry.id === 'a1');
45 if (main) main.balance_amount += 5000;
46 const moved = state.transactions.find((entry) => entry.id === 't1');
47 if (moved) moved.account_id = 'a1';
48 return { status: 204 };
49 };
50 return state;
51}

213/** Recorrência diária de 9.000 centavos que começou há 3 dias, preparada pela API. */
214async function prepareRecurrence(page: Page, description: string) {
215 const accounts = await api<Schemas['AccountPage']>(page, 'GET', '/accounts');
216 const account = accounts.items[0];
217 if (!account) throw new Error('pessoa sem conta padrão');
218 const startsOn = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
219 await api(page, 'POST', '/recurring-transactions', {
220 account_id: account.id,
221 kind: 'expense',
222 description,
223 expected_amount: 9_000,
224 rule: {
225 frequency: 'daily',
226 interval: 1,
227 starts_on: startsOn,
228 time: '08:00',
229 timezone: 'America/Sao_Paulo',
230 },
231 });
232}
233
234/** Abre a ocorrência atrasada da recorrência e a liquida. */
235async function settleOverdue(page: Page, description: string) {
236 await page.goto('/finance/expenses?period=all&repetition=recurring');
237 const overdue = page
238 .getByRole('listitem')
239 .filter({ hasText: description })
240 .filter({ hasText: 'Atrasada' });
241 await overdue.first().getByRole('link', { name: description }).click();
242 await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Liquidar' }).click();
243 await expect(page.getByText(/^Liquidada\./)).toBeVisible();
244}

923/** Leva o foco pelo Tab até o gráfico do card; devolve se chegou. */
924async function tabToChart(page, name, limit = 120) {
925 for (let i = 0; i < limit; i += 1) {
926 await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
927 const inside = await page.evaluate(
928 (card) =>
929 document.activeElement?.classList.contains('recharts-surface') &&
930 [...document.querySelectorAll('section, [role="region"]')].some(
931 (region) =>
932 region.contains(document.activeElement) &&
933 region.querySelector('h2')?.textContent === card,
934 ),
935 name,
936 );
937 if (inside) return true;
938 }
939 return false;
940}

108/** Tira a ocorrência aberta e a previsão das listas na hora; o saldo não muda (RN-01). */
109export function useDeleteRecurringTransaction(id: string) {
110 const client = useQueryClient();
111 // Sem variáveis: os tipos vêm da inferência (`void` explícito não passa no lint).
112 return useMutation({
113 mutationFn: () => api.delete<undefined>(`/recurring-transactions/${id}`),
114 onMutate: async (): Promise<{ saved: Snapshot }> => {
115 const prefixes = [financeKeys.transactions, financeKeys.recurring(id)];
116 await cancel(client, prefixes);
117 const saved = snapshot(client, prefixes);
118 // Somem a ocorrência aberta e a previsão; as cópias liquidadas têm id e ficam no histórico (RF-03).
119 mapPages<TransactionItem>(client, financeKeys.transactions, (items) =>
120 items.filter((item) => item.id != null || item.recurrence_id !== id),
121 );
122 return { saved };
123 },
124 onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
125 restore(client, context?.saved);
126 warnRefusal(error);
127 },
128 onSuccess: () => {
129 // A tela sai da página logo depois; reler a recorrência daria 404.
130 void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financeKeys.recurring(id), refetchType: 'none' });
131 },
132 onSettled: () => {
133 void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financeKeys.transactions });
134 void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: financeKeys.summary });
135 },
136 });
137}

612 await page.mouse.down();
613 await page.mouse.move(box.x + box.width - 2, y, { steps: 30 });
614 await page.mouse.up();
615 } else {
616 // Em 360 px o texto passa da largura da janela: seleciona o trecho pelo DOM.
617 await text.first().evaluate((el) => {

619 });

622 await toolbar.waitFor();

648async function recordHighlightColorVideo(browser, base) {
649 mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
650 const size = { width: 1280, height: 800 };
651 const recording = await browser.newContext({
652 viewport: size,
653 locale: 'pt-BR',
654 timezoneId: ZONE,
655 recordVideo: { dir: join(OUT, 'video-tmp'), size },
656 });
657 await recording.addInitScript(CURSOR_MARKER);
658 await recording.addInitScript(
659 ([k, t]) => {
660 try {
661 localStorage.setItem(k, t);
662 } catch {
663 /* sem armazenamento */
664 }
665 },
666 ['atria_theme', 'light'],
667 );
668 const recState = await installApi(recording, 'normal', Promise.resolve());
669 const rec = await recording.newPage();
670 const recErrors = [];
671 rec.on('pageerror', (e) => recErrors.push(e.message));
672 const video = rec.video();
673 const pause = (ms) => rec.waitForTimeout(ms);
674 const click = async (locator) => {
675 const box = await locator.boundingBox();
676 await rec.mouse.move(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2, { steps: 25 });
677 await pause(500);
678 await rec.mouse.down();
679 await rec.mouse.up();
680 await pause(900);
681 };
682 try {
683 await gotoReader(rec, base);
684 await waitPageDrawn(rec, OPEN_PAGE);
685 await rec.mouse.move(640, 700);
686 await pause(1200);
687 const toolbar = await selectPassage(rec, true);
688 await pause(1200);
689 await click(toolbar.getByRole('button', { name: 'Destacar em outra cor' }));
690 const panel = rec.getByRole('group', { name: 'Cor do novo destaque' });
691 await panel.waitFor();
692 await pause(800);
693 await click(panel.getByRole('button', { name: /^Cor do destaque/ }));
694 const dialog = rec.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Escolher cor' });
695 await dialog.waitFor();
696 await pause(800);
697 const hex = dialog.getByLabel('HEX');
698 await hex.fill('');
699 await hex.pressSequentially(CHOSEN.toUpperCase(), { delay: 120 });
700 await pause(1000);
701 await click(dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Aplicar' }));
702 await click(panel.getByRole('button', { name: 'Destacar', exact: true }));
703 const mark = pageRegion(rec, OPEN_PAGE).locator(`span[data-color="${CHOSEN}"]`);
704 await mark.first().waitFor();
705 await pause(500);
706 check(
707 'vídeo: POST com color #db2777',
708 recState.bodies.some((c) => c.startsWith('POST') && c.includes(`"color":"${CHOSEN}"`)),
709 recState.bodies.join(' | '),
710 );
711 const background = await mark.first().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor);
712 check(
713 'vídeo: marca na cor escolhida',
714 background !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && background !== 'transparent',
715 background,
716 );
717 check('vídeo: sem erro de JS', recErrors.length === 0, recErrors.join(' | '));
718 await pause(2500);
719 } catch (e) {
720 check('vídeo: cenário executou', false, String(e.message).split('\n')[0]);
721 } finally {
722 await recording.close();
723 }
724 const path = join(OUT, 'reader-highlight-color.webm');
725 await video.saveAs(path);
726 rmSync(join(OUT, 'video-tmp'), { recursive: true, force: true });
727 console.log(`video: ${relative(ROOT, path)}`);
728}

209/** Marcador do cursor no vídeo: o Playwright não desenha o ponteiro. */
210function cursorMarker() {
211 const dot = document.createElement('div');
212 dot.style.cssText =
213 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;pointer-events:none;left:0;top:0;display:none;';
214 dot.innerHTML =
215 '<div style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#e11d48;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #000"></div>' +
216 '<div data-label style="margin:4px 0 0 14px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:#111;color:#fff;font:600 12px system-ui;white-space:nowrap"></div>';
217 const label = dot.querySelector('[data-label]');
218 const place = (event: MouseEvent) => {
219 dot.style.display = 'block';
220 dot.style.transform = `translate(${String(event.clientX - 6)}px, ${String(event.clientY - 6)}px)`;
221 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
222 const under = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
223 if (label)
224 label.textContent = `cursor: ${under ? getComputedStyle(under).cursor : 'default'}`;
225 });
226 };
227 window.addEventListener('mousemove', place, true);
228 window.addEventListener('mousedown', place, true);
229 window.addEventListener('mouseup', place, true);
230 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
231 document.body.append(dot);
232 });
233}
